title: Freddie's sneaky pete, a union man and the envied suits
summary: Freddie hid a gallon of cheap wine behind his drums, and a union delegate named Huey forced Butler to join the local, while Freddie wanted suits like Butler's.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

in Canada
yes, Freddie -- now, we have/ -- they got all the nice whiskey

Now, we are wailing and people are coming from

After a while, there was one cat up there named
Huey. He had a union. He told me, you going through the union,
and he told me, said, you going through the union, said I've gone to the union, and he said, you quit your union and join my union and we gonna run you out of here if you don't join this union.
And Freddie -- and Freddie says and by the way, I don't understand why he got them pretty suits and I have to have some of them too.
The man said, what does the suits got to do with the band, figures I'm Canadian and this man's coming up here trying to make us look bad -- so, Freddie -- then, he tells me how much he loves me.

I said, Freddie, I'll take you to the tailor where you can get a couple of them too and by the way, those full dress that you are wearing are mine and who told you to get that one, so Freddie say yes, I'm so sorry.
